entries.prompt: Bright stylised low-poly alpine ski-resort style, chunky simple faceted shapes, clean flat colours with soft shading, warm and cosy. A cheerful young woman ski instructor, full body, standing in a T-pose facing the camera, arms straight out to the sides, legs slightly apart. Adult proportions about six heads tall, so the head is about one sixth of her height; arms long enough to reach mid-thigh when lowered. A fitted red ski jacket with a cream stripe across the chest, no wider than her shoulders; slim navy ski trousers; chunky orange ski boots; mittens; short hair tucked completely under a snug knitted beanie; goggles resting flat on the beanie. Clear space between the arms and the body and between the two legs. No skis, no poles, no scarf, no hood, no dangling straps or pom-pom, nothing loose. Single isolated object, centered, on a plain white background
animations: ski_glide: a skier holds a low ski stance with knees bent and feet together, arms bent forward at the sides, gently bobbing up and down in place

busiest_moment.when: past about 2,500 m at top speed: rows every ~7.5 m, ~6.75 obstacles per row, 140 m of run visible
busiest_moment.triangles_with_shadow_pass: about 490,000 processed per frame (everything is drawn again into the shadow map)

texture_memory.as_exported: 8 models × 2K. One 2048² texture = 16 MB on the GPU, 21 MB with mipmaps. If each model has 3 maps (colour, normal, roughness/metal): 8 × 3 × 21 ≈ 512 MB. Too much for a phone.
texture_memory.plan: Instances share textures, so only the 8 unique models count. At load time: keep Juno at 2K with colour + normal (~43 MB), shrink every prop to 1K and keep only its colour map (7 × 5.3 MB ≈ 37 MB), dropping normal maps that a flat low-poly look does not need. Total ≈ 80 MB.

busiest_moment.draw_calls: ~280 objects, plus the same again for shadows ≈ 560 if each model is one mesh. In Stage 5, draw repeated props (trees, fences, rocks) as instanced meshes: ≈ 20–30 draw calls.
busiest_moment.phone_verdict: Yes, with the Stage 5 plan: ~250k triangles is fine for a recent mid-range phone, textures shrunk to ~80 MB, and instancing for repeated props. Without shrinking the textures (~512 MB), older phones would likely run out of memory or reload the page.
